title: Spectral Geometry and the One-Loop QED $β$-Function on $S^3 \times S^1$
summary: We compute the one-loop QED $β$-function coefficient directly from heat kernel data of the twisted Spin$^c$ Dirac operator on $S^3 \times S^1$. Using $ζ$-function regularization, the logarithmic scale dependence is encoded in the $a_4$ coefficient of the spectral expansion. The $F_{μν} F^{μν}$ term in $a_4$ yields exactly $β(e) = e^3/(12π^2)$, independent of $r$, $L$, or background, verifying spectral RG flow without flat-space propagators.
